metadata.description: The official PM Bridge plugins, built and ready to install: each is installed from Settings > Integrations > Marketplaces and stays disabled until the owner enables it.

plugins.name: creator
plugins.description: Creates new plugins and skills in the standard format by chat, and checks them.

plugins.name: dev-loop
plugins.description: Step-by-step instructions for taking a dev ticket to a merge request and closing it only after the merge; it runs no program.

plugins.name: feishu
plugins.description: Brings Feishu groups and chats into PM Bridge groups: their messages come in, and you can send to them from the app, images and files too.

plugins.name: gitlab
plugins.description: Work with GitLab projects, branches, merge requests and pipelines; it can never merge.

plugins.name: knowledge
plugins.description: Searches YouTrack articles and your local folders together as one knowledge base.

plugins.name: mac-mail
plugins.description: Reads the mail already on this Mac in Apple Mail (and in Legacy Outlook) and can never send, move, delete or mark anything.
